frameworks.name: Target Profile Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate architecture, operating system, ABI, pointer width and byte order as one coherent target profile.

frameworks.name: ABI Contract Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate calling convention, pointer width, stack alignment and result-return convention.

frameworks.name: Feature Gate Framework
frameworks.purpose: Resolve unsupported CPU/platform features without silently granting missing capabilities.

frameworks.name: Cross-Build Framework
frameworks.purpose: Check host/target selection against the explicitly declared compiler target set.

frameworks.name: Memory Map Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate typed address regions for positive sizes, overflow-safe bounds and pairwise non-overlap.

frameworks.name: Environment Manifest Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate environment key/value pairs, canonical key spelling and duplicate-free variables.

frameworks.name: Configuration Overlay Framework
frameworks.purpose: Resolve a key through ordered configuration layers; the last matching layer wins.

frameworks.name: Working Root Framework
frameworks.purpose: Reject absolute, empty and parent-traversal paths before they enter a workspace boundary.

frameworks.name: Profile Chain Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate an ordered environment profile chain with unique non-empty profile identifiers.

frameworks.name: Locale Fallback Framework
frameworks.purpose: Resolve the requested locale, then explicit fallback, then deterministic English fallback.

frameworks.name: Service Graph Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate acyclic service start dependencies and reject backward/self/out-of-range edges.

frameworks.name: Resource Allocator Framework
frameworks.purpose: Compute per-pool residual capacity after validating equal dimensions and bounded non-negative requests.

frameworks.name: Readiness Gate Framework
frameworks.purpose: Apply a minimum-ready quorum over validated service states.

frameworks.name: Failure Domain Framework
frameworks.purpose: Require replicas to occupy the declared minimum number of distinct failure domains.

frameworks.name: Health Reducer Framework
frameworks.purpose: Reduce a service-state set to the worst bounded health state: healthy, degraded or unhealthy.

frameworks.name: Layer Architecture Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate ordered layers and strictly forward dependencies to guarantee an acyclic layer graph.

frameworks.name: Impact Cone Framework
frameworks.purpose: Compute the transitive downstream impact set of a changed architecture node.

frameworks.name: Coupling Matrix Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate a square non-negative coupling matrix and return its node count and directed edge count.

frameworks.name: Module Boundary Framework
frameworks.purpose: Reject dependencies that cross a forbidden module boundary or violate public/private visibility policy.

frameworks.name: Contract Compatibility Framework
frameworks.purpose: Check semantic-version compatibility: equal major version and offered minor/patch not older than required.

frameworks.name: Integer Range Framework
frameworks.purpose: Check fixed-width signed/unsigned integer bounds for the requested bit width.

frameworks.name: Checked Addition Framework
frameworks.purpose: Perform checked integer addition under an explicit signedness and width contract.

frameworks.name: Checked Multiplication Framework
frameworks.purpose: Perform checked integer multiplication and reject width overflow.

frameworks.name: Ratio Normalization Framework
frameworks.purpose: Reduce an integer ratio by GCD and normalize denominator sign.

frameworks.name: Address Alignment Framework
frameworks.purpose: Round an address upward to a validated power-of-two alignment within 64-bit address space.

frameworks.name: Boot Order Framework
frameworks.purpose: Verify a caller-supplied startup ordering against all dependency edges.

frameworks.name: Bootstrap Order Framework
frameworks.purpose: Produce a deterministic topological startup order using the smallest ready step first.

frameworks.name: Preflight Gate Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate named preflight checks and enforce a minimum passing count.

frameworks.name: Rollback Plan Framework
frameworks.purpose: Generate reverse-order compensation steps from a unique completed-step journal.

frameworks.name: Checkpoint Selector Framework
frameworks.purpose: Select the highest-numbered valid checkpoint after validating the checkpoint journal.

frameworks.name: Primitive Registry Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate a unique list of primitive type names from the supported Reaper scalar set.

frameworks.name: Unit Scale Framework
frameworks.purpose: Convert byte-oriented units to an exact byte count with overflow bounds.

frameworks.name: Invariant Framework
frameworks.purpose: Check a scalar against an explicit inclusive lower/upper invariant.

frameworks.name: Result Envelope Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate tagged ok/err result envelopes and reject malformed error payloads.

frameworks.name: Diagnostic Severity Framework
frameworks.purpose: Map stable diagnostic code prefixes to error/warning/info severity.

frameworks.name: Spine Chain Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate ordered unique node identifiers for a linear spine.

frameworks.name: Spine Index Framework
frameworks.purpose: Return the deterministic index of a node or -1 when absent.

frameworks.name: Spine Tree Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate a rooted tree with one parent per non-root node and full root reachability.

frameworks.name: Spine Cycle Framework
frameworks.purpose: Detect whether a directed dependency graph contains a cycle.

frameworks.name: Spine Path Framework
frameworks.purpose: Collapse adjacent repeated identifiers while preserving path order.

frameworks.name: Retry Schedule Framework
frameworks.purpose: Generate a bounded exponential retry delay schedule with a hard cap.

frameworks.name: Queue Admission Framework
frameworks.purpose: Admit incoming work only when current plus incoming depth remains within queue capacity.

frameworks.name: Route Selection Framework
frameworks.purpose: Select the longest matching topic-prefix route deterministically.

frameworks.name: Topic Fanout Framework
frameworks.purpose: Return unique subscribers bound to an exact topic.

frameworks.name: Message Envelope Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate message ID, schema version, topic and bounded payload size.

frameworks.name: Record Layout Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate field ranges fit a record and do not overlap.

frameworks.name: Hierarchy Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate a rooted parent vector with exactly one root and no out-of-range parents.

frameworks.name: Matrix Shape Framework
frameworks.purpose: Return rectangular matrix dimensions or an empty list for ragged input.

frameworks.name: Field Alignment Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate offset alignment and non-overlap for typed fields.

frameworks.name: Coverage Framework
frameworks.purpose: Report missing structural slots while rejecting malformed and duplicate slot IDs.

frameworks.name: Artifact Manifest Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate unique build artifact names, supported artifact kinds and bounded sizes.

frameworks.name: Variant Selection Framework
frameworks.purpose: Select the first build variant whose required feature set is available.

frameworks.name: Build Flag Merge Framework
frameworks.purpose: Merge key/value build flags with local values overriding inherited flags.

frameworks.name: Build Cost Framework
frameworks.purpose: Sum non-negative bounded build-step costs with a deterministic ceiling.

frameworks.name: Artifact Graph Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate a directed acyclic graph of build artifacts and transformations.

frameworks.name: Peer Mesh Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate duplicate-free directed peer links and self-link restrictions.

frameworks.name: Peer Availability Framework
frameworks.purpose: Return required ecosystem peers that are not currently available.

frameworks.name: Version Matrix Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate unique peer semantic versions and require one compatible major line.

frameworks.name: Peer Quorum Framework
frameworks.purpose: Require a minimum healthy peer quorum across known peer states.

frameworks.name: Capability Owner Framework
frameworks.purpose: Select the first declared peer that provides a requested capability.

frameworks.name: Overlay Merge Framework
frameworks.purpose: Merge ordered key/value layers with the last layer taking precedence.

frameworks.name: Overlay Conflict Framework
frameworks.purpose: Report keys assigned different values by multiple overlay layers.

frameworks.name: Overlay Patch Framework
frameworks.purpose: Apply a key/value patch to a base map while preserving stable key order.

frameworks.name: Overlay Tombstone Framework
frameworks.purpose: Remove tombstoned overlay entries from a list of [key, value, deleted] records.

frameworks.name: Overlay Priority Framework
frameworks.purpose: Choose the value with the highest declared priority.

frameworks.name: Shell Command Request Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate a structured command request without launching the command.

frameworks.name: Shell Allowlist Framework
frameworks.purpose: Check that a requested command is present in an explicit allowlist.

frameworks.name: Shell Pipeline Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate a sequence of command stages with explicit pipe compatibility.

frameworks.name: Shell Argument Vector Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate an explicit argument vector and reject embedded line breaks or invalid value types.

frameworks.name: Shell Exit Status Framework
frameworks.purpose: Classify a process exit status without launching a process.

frameworks.name: Runtime Quota Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate positive step, call-depth, heap-byte and collection quotas.

frameworks.name: Runtime Step Admission Framework
frameworks.purpose: Admit a requested step reservation only when current plus requested stays within the limit.

frameworks.name: Runtime Resource Ledger Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate named resource entries and compute their total units.

frameworks.name: Runtime Cancellation Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate state transitions for a cooperative execution cancellation token.

frameworks.name: Runtime Budget Framework
frameworks.purpose: Return remaining budget after validating a non-negative reservation.

frameworks.name: Execution Profile Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate hosted/freestanding/boot/kernel/MCU mode against allocator, threading and host-I/O settings.

frameworks.name: Execution Phase Framework
frameworks.purpose: Require the lifecycle phases load, initialize, run and shutdown in canonical order.

frameworks.name: Scheduler Weight Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate unique task IDs and bounded positive integer scheduler weights.

frameworks.name: Resource Lifetime Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate resource acquisition/release intervals and unique resource identifiers.

frameworks.name: Host Effect Policy Framework
frameworks.purpose: Require requested host effects to be granted, allowlisted and not denied.

frameworks.name: Engine Pipeline Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate type continuity between ordered compiler/execution stages.

frameworks.name: Optimization Pass Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate unique optimization passes ordered by non-decreasing compiler phase.

frameworks.name: Backend Feature Framework
frameworks.purpose: Return target-required features unavailable in the chosen code-generation backend.

frameworks.name: Engine Cache Key Framework
frameworks.purpose: Create a stable delimiter-joined cache identity from non-empty text components.

frameworks.name: Optimization Budget Framework
frameworks.purpose: Admit an optimization plan only when iterations times work items fit the declared budget.

frameworks.name: Interrupt Vector Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate unique interrupt vectors, handler names and architecture vector bounds.

frameworks.name: Privilege Transition Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate allowed user/kernel privilege transitions and explicit transition reasons.

frameworks.name: Memory Protection Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate non-overlapping kernel memory regions and reject writable-executable mappings.

frameworks.name: Syscall Contract Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate unique syscall numbers/names and bounded argument counts.

frameworks.name: Kernel Handle Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate object handle IDs, generations, kinds and ownership identities.

frameworks.name: Dependency Constraint Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate dependency major line and inclusive minor-version interval.

frameworks.name: Export Table Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate unique public symbol names and non-empty type signatures.

frameworks.name: Module Visibility Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate module IDs and public/private visibility declarations.

frameworks.name: Library Dependency Graph Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate module dependency edges as a directed acyclic graph.

frameworks.name: Version Selection Framework
frameworks.purpose: Select the highest semantic version on a required major compatibility line.

frameworks.name: Toolchain Manifest Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate unique tool names with explicit versions and target identifiers.

frameworks.name: Build Command Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate a structured tool invocation with an explicit executable and text argument vector.

frameworks.name: Tool Capability Framework
frameworks.purpose: Resolve the first tool that provides a requested capability.

frameworks.name: Tool Output Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate a bounded tool output record with exit status, output length and stable tool ID.

frameworks.name: Toolchain Compatibility Framework
frameworks.purpose: Check whether a tool explicitly declares support for a requested target triple.

frameworks.name: Diagnostic Record Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate source-aware Reaper diagnostic records and stable code/severity fields.

frameworks.name: Tool Invocation Graph Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate an acyclic tool invocation dependency graph.

frameworks.name: Tool Input Contract Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate required named inputs and reject duplicate or untyped input declarations.

frameworks.name: Tool Result Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate a structured tool result with status, bounded duration, and output artifact list.

frameworks.name: Tool Capability Profile Framework
frameworks.purpose: Return the missing required capabilities for a selected tool profile.

frameworks.name: Capability Composition Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate toolkit composition where every component requirement is provided by the composition.

frameworks.name: Toolkit Profile Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate one toolkit profile with unique modules and a bounded resource budget.

frameworks.name: Extension Slot Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate unique extension slots and typed binding names.

frameworks.name: Toolkit Compatibility Framework
frameworks.purpose: Require all selected components to support one common ABI version.

frameworks.name: Toolkit Resource Plan Framework
frameworks.purpose: Compute residual toolkit resource capacity after validating component allocations.

frameworks.name: Package Manifest Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate package identity, semantic version, checksum metadata and package format.

frameworks.name: Package Version Range Framework
frameworks.purpose: Check a semantic version against an inclusive major/minor range.

frameworks.name: Package Path Framework
frameworks.purpose: Reject absolute, traversal, drive-prefixed and empty package archive paths.

frameworks.name: Package Lock Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate duplicate-free locked package identities and exact semantic versions.

frameworks.name: Package Dependency Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate direct package dependencies and reject self-dependency or duplicate dependency names.

frameworks.name: Stack Frame Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate frame metadata and bounded local-slot counts.

frameworks.name: Stack Budget Framework
frameworks.purpose: Admit a frame push only when frame bytes remain within the stack budget.

frameworks.name: Call Chain Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate a non-empty call chain within a maximum depth and without empty names.

frameworks.name: Stack Alignment Framework
frameworks.purpose: Check stack-pointer alignment against a power-of-two ABI requirement.

frameworks.name: Unwind Plan Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate reverse-order unwind actions for a unique resource acquisition sequence.

frameworks.name: Technology Layer Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate unique ordered technology layers with explicit role assignments.

frameworks.name: Technology Compatibility Framework
frameworks.purpose: Require adjacent technology layers to declare matching interface versions.

frameworks.name: Technology Target Matrix Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate a rectangular target-support matrix with unique target and layer IDs.

frameworks.name: Technology Integration Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate declared directed integrations between distinct technology layers.

frameworks.name: Technology Migration Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate an ordered migration plan with contiguous step numbers and non-empty actions.

frameworks.name: Template Parameter Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate unique typed template parameters and explicit required/optional flags.

frameworks.name: Template Placeholder Framework
frameworks.purpose: Report placeholders that have no supplied replacement value.

frameworks.name: Template Version Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate a versioned template identity and supported schema version.

frameworks.name: Template Expansion Budget Framework
frameworks.purpose: Bound template expansion by source size, instance count and output ceiling.

frameworks.name: Template Path Framework
frameworks.purpose: Reject unsafe template output paths before generation.

frameworks.name: Skeleton Manifest Framework
frameworks.purpose: Require the declared project skeleton components with unique non-empty names.

frameworks.name: Skeleton Entrypoint Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate a relative source entrypoint and a declared exported symbol.

frameworks.name: Skeleton Layer Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate the skeleton's ordered module-layer graph.

frameworks.name: Skeleton Section Framework
frameworks.purpose: Report required project sections absent from a generated skeleton.

frameworks.name: Skeleton Initialization Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate a unique initialization sequence that begins with core and ends with entry.

frameworks.name: Boilerplate Token Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate unique named replacement tokens using an explicit placeholder prefix.

frameworks.name: Boilerplate Project Name Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate a portable project identifier without path or shell metacharacters.

frameworks.name: Boilerplate License Framework
frameworks.purpose: Accept only known SPDX license identifiers for generated boilerplate.

frameworks.name: Boilerplate Output Collision Framework
frameworks.purpose: Report generated output paths that appear more than once.

frameworks.name: Boilerplate Render Budget Framework
frameworks.purpose: Bound output size after token expansion based on source size and replacement count.

frameworks.name: Base Contract Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate unique base-layer components with explicit version and stability class.

frameworks.name: Base Dependency Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate base-layer dependency edges as an acyclic graph.

frameworks.name: Base Limits Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate positive bounded core resource limits for a base profile.

frameworks.name: Base Compatibility Framework
frameworks.purpose: Check a version against an inclusive base compatibility interval.

frameworks.name: Base Invariant Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate a base set of unique named numeric invariants with ordered bounds.

frameworks.name: Adapter Contract Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate explicit typed adapters between distinct source and destination layers.

frameworks.name: Type Mapping Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate explicit unique source/target type conversion declarations.

frameworks.name: Protocol Version Framework
frameworks.purpose: Require producer and consumer to agree on a supported protocol major version.

frameworks.name: Typed Flow Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate type continuity across a sequence of interlayer connections.

frameworks.name: Adapter Order Framework
frameworks.purpose: Validate an ordered adapter graph with no duplicate or backward edges.
